answer: The grove cap is enforced at intake and jade shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a jetty tag. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The deposit is 25 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
